text: 中国联通在港交所公告：2026上半年收入表现稳健，在行业整体增长面临挑战的情况下，营业收入人民币2,014亿元，同比提升0.6%；受增值税及人工成本投入节奏变化影响，盈利短期承压，预计全年利润降幅将明显收窄，2026上半年净利润人民币95亿元，同比下降34.6%。算力收入人民币419亿元，同比增长13%，其中智算中心收入同比增长11%，智能计算收入同比增长9%。
text_en: China Unicom announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange: First-half 2026 revenue was stable, with operating revenue of RMB 201.4 billion, up 0.6% year-on-year, despite challenges in overall industry growth. Profitability faced short-term pressure due to changes in VAT and labor cost investment timing, with full-year profit decline expected to narrow significantly. First-half 2026 net profit was RMB 9.5 billion, down 34.6% year-on-year. Computing power revenue was RMB 41.9 billion, up 13% year-on-year, with intelligent computing center revenue up 11% and intelligent computing revenue up 9%.
